ideas.pitch: A Python CLI utility that ingests unknown tabular competition datasets, automatically handles missing data, engineers interaction features, and optimizes an XGBoost and LightGBM ensemble within a strict 30-minute time cap.
ideas.problem_statement: The ML Competition: online individual machine-learning competition focused on predictive modelling, data analysis, and applied machine-learning problem solving.
ideas.title: AutoML Rapid-Pipeline Baseline Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: In a rapid 90-120 minute predictive modelling sprint, competitors lose crucial time writing boilerplate preprocessing code. This tool automates baseline generation instantly, mirroring winning architectures like patient-readmission-prediction.

ideas.pitch: An integrity verification script that scans training data splits, ID columns, and target correlations to catch accidental data leakage or target-id mapping before model submission.
ideas.problem_statement: The ML Competition: Participants must not manipulate or access hidden test labels. Data leakage, unauthorized access to evaluation data or attempts to obtain hidden answers are prohibited.
ideas.title: LeakGuard: Automated Data Leakage and Overfitting Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Data leakage is the #1 reason competitors get disqualified or crash on test sets in fast ML competitions. Offering an automated safeguard addresses the strict rule-enforcement criterion.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight Streamlit interface designed for quick inference evaluation that calculates and visualizes SHAP values instantly for tree-based models.
ideas.problem_statement: The ML Competition: Participants will work with the provided problem statement and dataset to understand the data, preprocess inputs, develop suitable machine-learning models, evaluate their approaches and generate the required predictions.
ideas.title: SHAP-Fast: Real-time Feature Attribution Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in predictive modelling competitions appreciate interpretability alongside raw metric performance, directly applying proven explainability patterns from winning health/ML projects.

ideas.pitch: A modular validation script that matches obscure custom evaluation metrics published in competition guidelines, setting up local cross-validation folds that mirror the official leaderboard setup.
ideas.problem_statement: The ML Competition: Submissions will be evaluated using the published performance metric and may undergo technical verification before the final results are announced.
ideas.title: MetricSnap: Custom Evaluation Metric Harness
ideas.why_it_could_win: Relying on standard MSE or Accuracy when the competition uses a custom weighted F1 or AUC metric leads to misaligned models. A plug-and-play evaluation harness ensures exact alignment with the scoring engine.

ideas.pitch: A deterministic post-processing script that checks row counts, validates column headers, strips NaN values, and outputs correctly compressed CSV submission files matching exact contest schemas.
ideas.problem_statement: The ML Competition: Final predictions must be submitted in the required format and must follow the specified dataset, tools, evaluation metric, submission format and competition rules.
ideas.title: Submisi: Format Validator & Submission Auto-Formatter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Countless competitors lose points simply due to formatting errors or misaligned row indexes in their final CSV outputs. A strict automated sanity-check eliminates formatting submission failures.
